header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ Censures Hadhrat Ibn Rawaaha (RA)

blocks.text: (RA) with an army. Hadhrat Ibn Rawaaha (RA) let the others proceed ahead and said to them, "I shall remain behind to perform the Jumu'ah salaah with Rasulullaah ﷺ. I shall then catch up with you." Rasulullaah ﷺ caught sight of him after performing the salaah and asked, "What prevented you from leaving with your companions in the morning?" Hadhrat Ibn Rawaaha (RA) replied, "I wanted to perform the Jumu'ah salaah with you and catch them up later." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Even if you spent everything on earth you would be unable to gain (the rewards of) their morning."[^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Rebukes one of the Sahabah (RA) who Delayed Marching in the Path of Allaah

Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Anas (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once commanded some Sahabah (RA) to march on a military expedition. One of them said to his wife, "I shall stay behind to perform salaah with Rasulullaah ﷺ. Thereafter, I can make salaam with him and bid him farewell. He would then make a du'aa for me that would reach the Day of Qiyaamah (and benefit me then)." After Rasulullaah ﷺ had completed the salaah, the man came forward to greet him. Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, "Do you know how far ahead your companions have gone?" "Yes," replied the Sahabi (RA), "They are ahead of me by half a day." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "I swear by the Being Who controls my life! They have excelled you in virtue by a measure that is greater than the distance between the east and the west."[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Commands a Battalion to Leave by Night

Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once commanded a battalion to leave. They asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Should we leave tonight or wait until the morning?" Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Would you not like to spend the night in a garden from amongst the magnificent gardens of Jannah?"[^3]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) Censures Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA) for Delaying his Departure

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abu Zur'ah bin Amr bin Jareer
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Zur'ah bin Amr bin Jareer narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once dispatched an army that included Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA). After the army had left, Hadhrat Umar (RA) saw Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) and asked, "What has kept you back?" Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) replied, "I wanted to leave after performing the Jumu'ah salaah."
